leads.name: Olivo di Contrada Gebbia (the millennial olive)

location.address: Via dell'Ulivo Millenario, Contrada Gebbia, Motta Sant'Anastasia, CT

leads.source: italy-masaf register (sheet_id 01/F781/CT/19, girth 830cm); corroborated by https://www.lasiciliainrete.it/directory-tangibili/listing/olivo-di-contrada-gebbia/ and https://luoghi.italianbotanicalheritage.com/en/the-centuries-old-olive-tree-in-motta-santanastasia/ (age given only as "supposed to be between 1,000 and 1,200 years old", no basis stated, so repeated as vaguely as the source gives it and not sharpened)
leads.reason: held as a lead on two independent grounds, either one enough on its own. (1) Distance/transport: Motta Sant'Anastasia is 10km from Catania's centre with no passenger rail connection and roughly a 1-hour bus trip, well past the ~30 minute day-trip boundary. (2) Access is not confirmed: italianbotanicalheritage.com places it "inside the almond and olive grove outside Contrada Gebbia" and gives only driving directions to the vicinity, with no stated public path or visiting arrangement, so 'can a visitor get in without asking anyone's permission' cannot be answered honestly yet. Motta Sant'Anastasia is not on our city queue; this is raw material for a future stand-alone entry, contingent on an access answer, not a Catania addition.

blocked.name: Fico magnolioide of Villa San Saverio (Scuola Superiore di Catania)

location.address: Villa San Saverio, Via Valdisavoia 9, Catania

blocked.source: italy-masaf register (sheet_id 04/C351/CT/19, girth 1200cm, height 25m); corroborated by https://www.archiviobollettino.unict.it/articoli/il-ficus-macrophylla-della-scuola-superiore-di-catania-riconosciuto-albero-monumentale and https://ssc.unict.it/about/villa-san-saverio/
blocked.reason: blocked: access. Villa San Saverio is the residential campus of the Scuola Superiore di Catania (University of Catania's selective graduate school); the site is controlled by a 24-hour reception desk that screens students, staff and visitors (per search results on the school's own site). No evidence found of genuine open public access, a public path through the grounds, or published visiting hours for outsiders. Fails the 'can they get in without asking anyone's permission' test. The tree itself is real, alive and well-documented (12m girth, second Moreton Bay fig in the Catania cluster after the 14m one in Villa Bellini, cat_001) so this is a lead to revisit if evidence of open days or public garden access ever turns up, not a dead end about the tree.
